name: github
title: GitHub
description: Your pull requests, issues, repositories and notifications, and a search over all of GitHub. Signs in through the gh CLI or a token.
author: pal

settings.label: Token
settings.description: A personal access token (repo, notifications, read:org). Leave empty to use the gh CLI's login.

settings.label: Organisation
settings.description: An organisation whose recently pushed repositories are listed, and an owner the Create repository form offers.

settings.label: Clones folder
settings.description: Where your clones live (<root>/<name> or <root>/<owner>/<name>): enables Checkout on a pull request and Open in editor on a repository.

settings.label: Merged within
settings.description: How far back the Merged list of Pull Requests reaches.

prs.title: Pull Requests
prs.description: Yours, the ones waiting on your review, and what merged lately.

keys.title: Mark a draft ready for review

issues.title: Issues
issues.description: Assigned to you, mentioning you, opened by you; Create issue.

repos.title: Repositories
repos.description: Yours, starred, and your organisation's recently pushed.

keys.title: Open the clone in the editor
Open the path typed in the bar

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Unread, by reason; opening one marks it read.

search.title: Search GitHub
search.description: GitHub's search syntax over issues, pull requests, repositories and users.

keys.title: Everything, Issues and PRs, Repositories, Users

prs.title: Pull requests
prs.description: Separate PR status item over your own pull requests: red needs attention, amber is awaiting review or checks, green is ready to merge, muted is waiting; a review asked of you is a blue count only with `review_requests` on. The popover shows every bucket, reviews included, with the PR title, repo, state and age.

attention.title: Needs attention, with review requests on

settings.label: Review requests on the strip
settings.text: Count the pull requests waiting on your review
settings.description: Off (the default) keeps the Pull requests item to your own PRs, whose checks and reviews are yours to act on; a review asked of you is someone else's work and sits in the popover's own bucket either way.

keys.title: Open the focused pull request on GitHub
Copy the focused pull request's URL
Mute the focused pull request: out of the lists, the count and this popover until unmuted from the palette's Muted filter
Move between pull requests (or j and k)

issues.title: Issues
issues.description: Separate Issues status item: assigned, mentioned, and your own open issues use distinct colours. The popover shows those buckets with the issue title, repo, labels, comments and age.

keys.title: Open the focused issue on GitHub
Mute the focused issue: out of the lists, the count and this popover until unmuted from the palette's Muted filter
Move between issues (or j and k)

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: The unread count as a badge, hidden at zero; the popover lists the unread threads by repository with their reason, opens or marks them read, marks all read.

keys.title: Mark the thread read and open it on GitHub
Move between threads (or j and k)

store.tagline: Pull requests, issues, repos and notifications in the panel
features: Pull Requests: yours, the ones waiting on your review, and what merged this week, with the checks, the review decision and a draft or conflicts tag on the row
The detail pane on a pull request or issue: the body, the latest comments and reviews, every check by name, who approved
Repositories: yours, your organisation's recently pushed and your stars; `cmd+e` opens the local clone in the editor
Notifications by reason, newest first; `enter` marks the thread read and opens it, `cmd+shift+a` marks all read
Search GitHub as you type: `repo:acme/widgets is:pr`, `author:mara`, `label:bug`, results sectioned by kind
Create issue and Create repository as forms; Checkout branch and Merge from the row

screenshots.caption: Pull Requests: Mine, Review requested and Merged, with the checks and the review decision on each row

Notifications by reason, newest first; the first row is the unread count
Search GitHub: repositories, issues, pull requests and users for one query
On the menu bar: the GitHub glyph with the unread count as a red badge
The same item on a light menu bar
A click opens the popover: the unread threads by repository with their reason and age; Enter opens one, m marks it read, a marks all read

actions.title: Open
actions.description: The pull request, issue, repository, notification or profile on GitHub; a notification is marked read first.

actions.title: Checkout branch
actions.description: gh pr checkout in the clone under repos_root.

actions.title: Mute / Unmute
actions.description: Keeps an open pull request or issue out of the lists, the counts and the bar popovers; the Muted filter lists them to unmute.

actions.title: Open in editor
actions.description: The local clone, in code or the system opener.

actions.title: Open path
actions.description: The path typed in the bar (the repository row's argument) on the default branch; a form when picked without it.

actions.title: Create repository
actions.description: A form: owner, name, description, private.
